title: nf-core/rnasplice pipeline - params.contrasts schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.contrasts. Either the id, variable, reference, target[, blocking] columns or the deprecated contrast, treatment, control columns, never both; the pipeline checks which are present and that the required values are set

treatment.errorMessage: Treatment must contain a syntactically valid name (letters, numbers, dots, underscores; must start with a letter or dot not followed by a number)

control.errorMessage: Control must contain a syntactically valid name (letters, numbers, dots, underscores; must start with a letter or dot not followed by a number)

target.errorMessage: Target must contain a syntactically valid name (letters, numbers, dots, underscores; must start with a letter or dot not followed by a number)

reference.errorMessage: Reference must contain a syntactically valid name (letters, numbers, dots, underscores; must start with a letter or dot not followed by a number)
